bullets: 64 suction cups on the back help hold the mat on a smooth, clean surface.
Raised edges help keep food from spreading across the mat.
Made of silicone (listed by the maker as food grade).
20 x 20 x 1 cm, a size that suits cats and small to medium dogs.
Made for treats like peanut butter, yogurt, and pumpkin puree.
copy.description: Tired of treats ending up all over the floor? A lick mat keeps them in one place. This silicone slow feeder mat measures 20 x 20 x 1 cm and has 64 suction cups on the back to help it stay put on a smooth, clean surface. Its raised edges help keep food from spreading, so the bathroom, shower, or counter stays tidier. Spread peanut butter, yogurt, or pumpkin puree on the mat and let your pet lick it up. The mat is made of silicone (listed by the maker as food grade) and is listed for cats and for small and medium dogs. Choose a spread that is safe for your pet and check the surface before use. It is a simple way to give your pet a treat in a spot that is easy to tidy.

faq.q: How big is it, and who is it for?
faq.a: It measures 20 x 20 x 1 cm. It is made for cats and small to medium dogs, and it has no separate size options.
It is made of silicone (listed by the maker as food grade). Check that any spread you use is safe for your pet.
Estimate: 3–7 business days to the US, plus processing 1–3 days.

copy.safety_warning: Supervise your pet while it uses the mat. Stop use if the mat is torn, cracked, or has damaged or missing suction cups, since loose pieces can be a choking hazard. Only use spreads that are safe for pets; avoid any containing xylitol.
